blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan on Saturday, Sept. 19, said the passage of the Comprehensive School Safety Act is one way to address campus violence following another school shooting incident at a high school in South Cotabato. Pangilinan expressed sympathies to the families and students affected after a Grade 9 student opened fire
